# O2om (قُوم) — Ergonomic Desktop Focus & Stand-Up Companion

> O2om (derived from the Arabic imperative قُوم, meaning "Stand up!") is an open-source, high-performance desktop focus and posture companion for Windows built with Tauri v2 (Rust backend + React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS v4 frontend). It features multi-mode interval pacing (Pomodoro, Balanced Stand-Up, Eye Guard 20-20-20, Custom), step-by-step guided stretch routines, an edge-docking floating mini-pill widget, physical idle detection via Win32 GetLastInputInfo, single-instance process enforcement, quiet post-session transitions, and dual Arabic (RTL) & English localization.

## Technical Specifications

- Project Name: O2om (قُوم)
- Latest Release: v4.2.0
- Target Operating System: Windows 10 (1809+) & Windows 11 (64-bit x64)
- Desktop Runtime: Tauri v2.2+ (tauri, tauri-plugin-notification, tauri-plugin-autostart, tauri-plugin-single-instance)
- Backend Stack: Rust 2021 (tokio 100ms interval, tokio-rusqlite asynchronous connection with decoupled AppState mutex locks, windows-rs Win32 API, persistent rodio synthesized audio thread)
- Frontend Stack: React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand 5, Lucide React, i18next
- Process Model: Single-instance enforced (secondary launches focus the existing main window)
- Window Topology:
  - main: 420x490px dashboard, analytics, and configuration (hides to tray on close)
  - pill: 176x42px frameless floating micro-timer with Win32 WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW taskbar isolation and coordinate dock matching
  - break_overlay: 720x520px centered, always-on-top guided 5-step ergonomics stretch coach
- Tiling Window Manager Support: GlazeWM & Komorebi compatible (tiling_wm_mode setting disables edge-snapping)
- Physical Inactivity Detection: Win32 GetLastInputInfo physical idle detection (pauses work countdowns, never interrupts active breaks)
- Persistence Layer: Asynchronous SQLite via tokio-rusqlite in %APPDATA%\com.o2om.desktop\o2om.db with transactional integrity and auto-migration
- Runtime Footprint: ~30MB RAM, 0% idle CPU, no Electron or Chromium background bloat
- License: MIT License

## Core Architecture & Engine Contracts

```
[Tokio Interval 100ms]
         │
         ▼
[TimerEngine (Rust)] ───► [Win32 GetLastInputInfo] (Hardware Idle Detection)
         │
         ├───► Work Session Active ───► Inactivity Threshold ───► Pause & Flag Idle
         │
         ├───► Work Session Concluded ───► Quiet WaitingBreak (00:00, no nagging chimes)
         │
         ├───► User Initiates Break ───► Break Timer / Guided Stretch Overlay (720x520)
         │
         └───► Break Concluded ───► Rising Harmonic Audio Chime (rodio) ───► WaitingWork
```

## IPC Command API (Tauri Commands)

- get_state(): Returns TimerStateSnapshot (status, remaining_ms, cycle, progress).
- start_work(): Initiates or resumes focus session.
- start_break(guided: bool): Launches break session or displays break_overlay.
- skip_break(): Skips waiting break and returns directly to work mode.
- toggle_pause(): Toggles active countdown pause state.
- reset_timer(): Resets current session timer to baseline duration.
- snooze_timer(): Postpones break notification by configured snooze duration (default 5m).
- set_mode(mode: SessionMode): Switches interval preset (pomodoro, standup, eyeguard, custom).
- get_settings(): Loads persisted EngineSettings from SQLite.
- save_settings(settings: EngineSettings): Persists updated configuration and recalibrates engine.
- get_health_stats(): Queries today's stands, streak count, and historical focus minutes.
- get_weekly_history(): Retrieves daily completion records for the past 7 days.
- reset_all_stats(): Clears health history, daily stands, and active streaks while preserving user preferences.
- set_pill_mode(is_pill: bool): Switches window visibility between main dashboard and floating mini-pill.
- snap_pill_to_edge(): Computes monitor edge docking position for mini-pill.
- set_pill_tucked(tucked: bool): Tucks or un-tucks mini-pill behind screen border.
- close_break_overlay(): Dismisses stretch overlay and returns to main window.

## Local Persistence Schema (SQLite)

Database path: `%APPDATA%\com.o2om.desktop\o2om.db`

Tables:
1. `settings`: Single-row configuration key-value storage.
2. `daily_health_records`: Daily rows recording (date, stands_count, stand_goal, focus_minutes, goal_met).
3. `streaks_metadata`: Single-row tracking (current_streak_days, best_streak_days, last_active_date).
4. `active_session`: Ephemeral snapshot supporting zero-drift crash/restart hydration.
